feeds.title: Phoenix Fire Falconry
feeds.description: This blog is authored by Carolyn Standlee. She is a woman falconer, enjoying the Great Outdoors with a hawk on her fist. Follow the blog for her adventures and stories on falconry and her obsession with the birds.

feeds.title: Nevada Falconry
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to the sport of falconry. Follow to view photos, videos and learn about falconry in the northern nevada area.

feeds.title: Feathers and Fur Blog
feeds.description: Feathers and Fur Falconry Centre is a Berkshire based collection of Hawks, Falcons and Owls used to allow people the opportunity to experience falconry and the unique and wonderful bond between man and bird.

feeds.title: Total Raptor Experience Blog
feeds.description: This blog is all about falconry lessons and education programs, school outreach and free flight demonstrations in Southern California.

feeds.title: Sky Falconry Blog
feeds.description: Our mission at Sky Falconry is to educate the public through hands-on experiences free flying birds of prey. We aim to preserve the art of falconry, teach raptor biology and the need for conservation. Follow this blog for falconry lessons, raptor education and conservation in the mountains of San Diego.

feeds.title: Hawkeye Falconry UK
feeds.description: The Hawkeye team based in the Midlands have the experience and amazing birds of prey to provide you with exciting and dynamic flying demonstrations. Follow this blog for more updates.

feeds.title: Speyside Falconry Blog
feeds.description: Speyside Falconry is family run business providing falconry experiences educational talks and visits, animal therapy, events and other services.

feeds.title: International Falconry Academy
feeds.description: Find articles on Falconry courses, workshops, outings. Taught by a licensed falconer with over 40 years experience.

feeds.title: The Scottish Countryman Blog
feeds.description: The Scottish Countryman offers engaging and entertaining falconry and archery experiences to connect you to Fife's Scottish countryside. Follow this blog to discover more about the art of falconry and birding in Scotland.

feeds.title: Arizona Falconers Association
feeds.description: The purpose of the Arizona Falconers Association is to provide communication and interaction among interested members; to promote the ethical and legal pursuit of falconry as a recognized field sport; to promote the use of sound biological principles and information in the management of raptor populations and falconry; and to encourage programs of public education, scientific study and habitat conservation which advance the welfare of falconry and birds of prey.
